subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should macOS gateway service generation treat the Volta shim as an acceptable stable absolute Node path when no supported system/Homebrew Node is available?
rationale: The code boundary is small, but accepting the shim changes the managed-service runtime policy for version-manager users and conflicts with the current warning-first posture.

options.title: Support Volta shim fallback
options.body: Allow ~/.volta/bin/node as the stable fallback for Volta tools/image Node paths when the shim is executable and no supported system Node is selected.

options.title: Keep system Node policy
options.body: Reject Volta shim fallback and keep version-manager service runtimes warning-only, with docs pointing users to system/Homebrew Node for managed services.

options.title: Defer to broader version-manager policy
options.body: Fold this into the wider version-manager service-runtime discussion covering NVM, fnm, asdf, Volta, and configurable Node paths.

recommendation.title: Support Volta shim fallback
recommendation.body: Allow ~/.volta/bin/node as the stable fallback for Volta tools/image Node paths when the shim is executable and no supported system Node is selected.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the resolver precedent and authored the current system-Node preference logic, so they are the clearest owner for the policy tradeoff.
